INSERT INTO TB_ADVERTISEMENT ( applicant_user_id, business_name, manager_name, contact_phone, contact_email, ad_content, site_name, headline, description, image_url, image_url_right, link_url, ad_position, start_date, end_date, status )
VALUES ( #{applicantUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{businessName}, #{managerName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{adContent}, #{siteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{headline, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageUrlRight, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{linkUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adPosition}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 'PENDING_APPROVAL' )

INSERT INTO TB_ADVERTISEMENT_HISTORY ( ad_id, admin_user_id, action_type, from_status, to_status, recipient_email, mail_status )
VALUES ( #{adId}, NULL, 'SUBMITTED', NULL, 'PENDING_APPROVAL', #{recipientEmail}, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT ad_id AS adId, business_name AS businessName, site_name AS siteName, headline, description, image_url AS imageUrl, image_url_right AS imageUrlRight, link_url AS linkUrl, ad_position AS adPosition FROM TB_ADVERTISEMENT WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND ad_position = #{value} ORDER BY ad_id
